settings.heading: Capsules on Chalk
settings.text:
Larkfield Community Kitchen started in a church hall in 2009 with one soup pot and six volunteers. Today we run a choice pantry, cook a free lunch twice a week and deliver groceries to neighbours who can't get out.

Anyone who lives in Larkfield or the river villages is welcome. There are no forms, and nobody asks why you came.

settings.heading: Rows on Clay
settings.text: The ask band, with every pair at 4.5:1 or better.

settings.title: Is my gift tax-deductible?
settings.body: Yes. We send a tax receipt for every gift of $20 or more.

settings.title: How is my gift spent?
settings.body: On food, the van's fuel and keeping the hall warm.

settings.heading: Newsletter on Lake
settings.text: One email a month with what we cooked, who helped and what the pantry needs.
